title: Timeline, Calendar, Travel Window & Timed Event Planning
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Timeline, Calendar, Travel Window and Timed Event Planning over the MAS-01..08 foundations while preserving the boundary between prepared scheduling/planning semantics and canonical live time, travel, event occurrence and runtime mutation.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared Timeline, Calendar, Travel Window and Timed Event planning inside the MAS workspace without treating planned time or events as live elapsed time, travel completion, occurrence or canonical runtime mutation.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically plan timeline, calendar, travel-window and timed-event material over the completed MAS foundations with explicit references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving canonical time/travel/event runtime authority and never treating prepared planning as executed live truth.

selection_boundaries: Existing MAS validation family remains active; no family transition is authorized or required.
MAS-01 through MAS-08 remain foundational and are not reopened silently.

Timeline, Calendar, Travel Window and Timed Event structures are prepared planning semantics only; actual elapsed time, calendar advancement, completed travel, event occurrence, Action/Event emission and canonical mutation remain with targeted owner/runtime seams loaded during this tranche.
Planned or linked time/travel/event material never proves that time elapsed, a journey completed or a timed event occurred.
MAS-10 retains Encounter Composition, Challenge, Resource & Pacing Advisory scope and must not be pulled forward.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-10+ and SMB-08 remain unauthorized.
next_action: On the authorized application branch, load only MAS-08 plus targeted time/calendar/travel/event and runtime-owner seams, establish causal MAS-09 RED, then implement the minimum deterministic prepared-planning contract without pulling MAS-10 encounter/pacing work forward.
